name: Immich photo
description: Show random photos from your Immich library and label them from the Deck
config_help:
Shows a random photo from an Immich library, a different one on each refresh, fitted to the widget. Videos, archived and hidden photos are skipped.

**Immich address:** the address you open Immich at, e.g. `http://192.168.1.10:2283` or `https://photos.example.com`. HTTPS needs a certificate from a public CA; for a self-signed one use plain HTTP on the local network.

**API key:** create one in Immich under **Account Settings → API Keys** with the permissions `asset.read`, `asset.view`, `tag.read`, `tag.create` and `tag.asset`, and save it as a token account on the Deck.

**Label** and **Label 2:** each label set gets its own menu button. Tap the photo and choose e.g. **Label ToDelete** to tag the photo on screen in Immich; on a photo that already has the tag the button reads **Remove ToDelete**. Leave a label empty to hide its button.
